title: Γιορτές και φίλοι
description: Ten short stories about weddings, birthdays, name days, school celebrations, holidays and good times with friends in Greece and Cyprus.

lessons.title: Ένας μικρός γάμος
lessons.summary: Eleni and Nikos marry at the town hall; her friend Sofia is the witness, and at night everyone sings and dances.

lessons.title: Πάρτι έκπληξη στο διαμέρισμα
lessons.summary: Maria plans a surprise party for Dimitris and first visits her neighbours so that the party does not bother them.

lessons.title: Τα 80 χρόνια του κυρίου Στέλιου
lessons.summary: Eirini visits her father in a Cretan village on his 80th birthday; they take a walk and sit under the tree he planted as a boy.

lessons.title: Η 25η Μαρτίου στο σχολείο
lessons.summary: Petros writes a page about freedom for the school's 25 March celebration and reads it in front of the parents.

lessons.title: Η πριγκίπισσα στη σκηνή
lessons.summary: Anna plays the princess in a children's Christmas play and gets over her fear before her first appearance on stage.

lessons.title: Μια μέρα στο Ναύπλιο
lessons.summary: For Marina's birthday, Anna takes her to Nafplio, where they find the mark of the bullet from the murder of Kapodistrias.

lessons.title: Η ομάδα πήρε το πρωτάθλημα
lessons.summary: Giorgos and Kostas watch the last match in a café, their town's team wins the championship, and the news is everywhere.

lessons.title: Ο διαγωνισμός των Αποκριών
lessons.summary: Lena makes her own tree costume for the school's carnival contest, and her brother Aris agrees that her win is fair.

lessons.title: Η επιστροφή του Κώστα
lessons.summary: Kostas comes home to Cyprus after seven years abroad, and his friends welcome him with a party on a beach near Paphos.

lessons.title: Βόμβες σοκολάτας για καλό σκοπό
lessons.summary: Dafni and her friend Rena make chocolate bombs for a Christmas market that raises money for an animal charity, and the house ends up a mess.
